source.title: WMCT Leader Announcement (September 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Kevin Hays will become the new Leader of the WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT). Kevin was already working as a Member of the WMCT.

<!-- break -->
Kevin was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of September 3, 2026.

We thank Rubén López de Juan, who will remain as a Senior Member of WMCT, for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Kevin the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Kevin’s application was the only one received. You can view Kevin’s candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-kHWSu9vc5g5meN0pqQqqgD96SNVdMB3?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WMCT 负责人任命公告（2026 年 9 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Kevin Hays 将担任 WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）的新任负责人。Kevin 此前已是 WMCT 的成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Kevin，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 9 月 3 日生效。

我们感谢 Rubén López de Juan 担任负责人期间所做的工作。他将继续留任 WMCT 资深成员。我们也祝 Kevin 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们只收到了 Kevin 的申请。其申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-kHWSu9vc5g5meN0pqQqqgD96SNVdMB3?usp=drive_link)查看。
